grades.upper_bound_mechanism: symmetric quadratic estimate |g(u)-g(v)|<=(sqrt f(u)-sqrt f(v))^2, then monotonicity, continuity, partition/telescoping to constant g
grades.notes: Complete proof. (S) derived from x=f(y) with g>=0. Necessity: estimate (7) proved for all u,v; forces f strictly increasing, g nondecreasing, then continuous; uniform-continuity partition gives g constant, covering fixed points. Sufficiency verified for all c>=0. Only a trivially fillable detail (J<f(t) in left-continuity) left implicit.
